title: Object storage 1.0.0
description: What the Node adapter keeps for each named object (one file per object under <dataDirectory>/<binding>/), and the ndjson lines used to export and import it. Values are opaque to this component; the application's object classes read and write them. On Cloudflare the objects keep their own storage and this format is not used.

objects.description: Number of object lines that follow.

namespace.description: The binding name, for example ROOM.

name.description: The object name passed to getByName.

storage.description: Key to JSON value, as stored by storage.put.

alarm.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch of the pending alarm, or null.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of {namespace,name,storage,alarm} as JSON with keys sorted at every level.

objectFile.description: The file the Node adapter keeps: storage values as JSON text, written through a temporary file and renamed.
